svg.aria-label: Punching: place the film, together with its upper and lower release films, on a pre-chilled metal block and punch out a disc with a punch. Cool it first so it stiffens and the edges come out clean. Use a punch, not scissors, and do not pull on the film; re-measure the diameter after punching.
